entry.title: 3D Printing Replacement Typewriter Feet in TPU

link.title: 3D Printing Replacement Typewriter Feet in TPU

entry.summary: Some of my 3D-printed typewriter feet Why 3D print typewriter feet? Typewriter feet do more work than they usually get credit for: They keep the machine from sliding across smooth desks when typing or returning the carriage. They dampen vibrations and noise, making typing quieter and more comfortable. They protect both the desk surface underneath and the typewriter itself from scratches and den...
